{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Spear''''' was a pair of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvettes]] employed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The two corvettes were joined by another pair called [[Sharky (corvette group)|''Sharky'']] and several [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] to stop one of two [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|Escort carriers]] [[Prowler (escort carriers)|''Prowler'']] from being captured by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] ''[[Suelu]]''. The corvettes and fighters were destroyed by two [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]].
